title: defineRoute
summary: Bind a path to a route module while retaining its exact handler types.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: path is a URL pattern. module contains handlers, view exports, and an optional shouldRevalidate function.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A new route object containing the module exports and path.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Keep server and build helpers in their dedicated subpaths.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: The supplied path wins over any path field on the module. This helper does not register a route globally; include the result in the table passed to createDataRouter.
